description: This file defines a React component and server-side functions for creating a new note in a web application. It includes loaders and actions for data fetching and form submission, respectively, along with the React component for the 'New Note' form.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Ensures user authentication before showing the create form. Returns an empty JSON response if authenticated.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new note, including validation and error handling, then redirects or returns errors accordingly.

methods.name: NewNote
methods.description: React component rendering the form for creating a new note, managing form state, validation, and navigation.
